title: Engagement brief, decision record and handoff plan
scenario: An 8-week pilot at Corvane's Dunmore plant. The plant manager wants 'AI on the pumps' for a VP review, reliability wants fewer surprise bearing failures, controls was burned by a vendor box that cried wolf, security keeps raw data on site, the planner owns the work-order queue. Write the brief everyone signs before any code.
task: Frame the problem and compute today's cost from the inputs
Agree target metrics with measurement and owners, false alarms included
Cut scope, honour every site constraint, plan a measured thin slice
Write an ADR with real options and the customer-owned handoff list
acceptance: Graded by rubric only (grade.sh reports 0/0; the automated row does not apply)
Baseline cost arithmetic shown; metrics are numbers with owners
Every constraint honoured; scope cuts explained to the stakeholders
Handoff assets each have a client-side owner

practices.label: Week 6 Mon - framing and measurable outcomes
Week 6 Thu - customer-owned assets and the handoff pack
